profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am a determined and diligent problem solver who loves to build, create, and use technologies to have an impact on a user or a community. My goal is to keep my code clean and detail-oriented so that it is easily understandable and shows my understanding of the technologies I use.

Technologies:
Frameworks/Front-End: JavaScript, React.js, TypeScript, Angular
Databases/Back-End: Node.js, Express, PostreSQL, Python
Testing: Pytest, Cypress

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leveraged the Slack API to build a Slackbot in JavaScript to analyze conversations between counselors and supervisors
- Improved the user interface and design of our pre-chat form using Vue.js and the Vuetify framework
- Communicated product requirements for Slackbot to a cross-functional team of product designers and machine learning engineers

Technologies used: Vue.js, Vuetify, JavaScript, Slack API

positions.title: Teaching Assistant: Software Engineering
positions.description:
- Host an hour-long remediation class twice a week for targeted students to close content gaps
- Provide fellows accountability by reviewing and tracking progress on recent problem sets and problem-solving patterns
- Communicate class trends, wins, and challenges to the Executive Director and Chief Program Officer to chart content support

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 416 West 13th Street, Suite 309, New York, NY 10014
positions.description:
- Collaborated with front-end developers to create a full-stack web project to visualize employee timesheet data
- Assessed product to decide which tools to use, identified an MVP and the steps to get there with Trello
- Created a visual of employee data crucial to payroll using HighCharts and analyzed CSV data from company database

Technologies used: Node.js, Express.js, HTML5, CSS3

projects.title: SmallTalk
projects.description:
This app provides a space for users to practice small talk and networking with other users over a video chat, which can help improve their skills over time! 

This project utilizes:  React, Node.js, Express, WebRTC, react-bootstrap, Grommet, Socket.io, Knex, PostgreSQL, Git

projects.title: Gentry.io
projects.description:
Gentry.io is a heat map that visualizes gentrification from 2005 to 2018. Data is based on demographics, rent, and income from those that have bachelor degrees.

This project utilizes: Python, AWS Lambda, Pandas, Google Maps API, OpenData API, NYC Open Data API, and Milligram.
